200.description: The settings state after the write.

type.description: The capability class, drawn from the same set a workflow's connector `type` is.

allOf.description: A connector's capability class: the axis a workflow's connector declaration and a step type's connector slot are matched on.
allOf.title: ConnectorType

scope.description: Which group registered the adapter: `built-in` ships with the engine and is always available; `fixtures` is a mock used for demos and tests, never a production integration; `users` was added by this deployment.

allOf.description: Which group registered the connector adapter: `built-in` ships with the engine, `fixtures` is a mock used for demos and tests, `users` was added by this deployment.
allOf.title: ConnectorScope

configured.description: True when every required key resolves to a value.

key.description: The setting key, as the adapter declares it.

secret.description: Whether the value is a secret. A secret's value never leaves the engine: the response says that it is set, not what it is.

required.description: Whether the connector cannot run without this key.

source.description: `stored` when an operator has set the key; `unset` when nothing resolves.

value.description: Present only when `secret` is false and the key is set.

updatedAt.description: When an operator last wrote the settings; null when nothing was ever stored.

updatedBy.description: The operator who last wrote the settings, as the bearer token identified them.

400.description:
The body or query violates its declared shape; `message` names each violated rule.

`CONNECTOR_SETTINGS_INVALID`: The settings are refused; `issues` lists each offending `key` with a `reason` of `undeclared_key`, `missing_required_key`, `invalid_value`, `invalid_format`, `missing_pairing` or `would_be_dropped`.

oneOf.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
oneOf.title: NestHttpError

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.
